scope: CO-3i Worker queue and Redis resource metrics with producer freshness

candidate_identity.commit: The commit containing this report; source hashes below identify the validated implementation.

contract.owner: Worker only; disabled when metrics are disabled
contract.queue: Due pending/retry_wait durable jobs across types; age since available_at using the database clock; not Celery depth or expired running leases
contract.redis: INFO clients connected_clients for the shared Redis server; the legacy process-pool metric remains unknown
contract.freshness: Each Worker replica must provide success=1, a finite value and a last-success timestamp within 45 seconds, no more than 5 seconds ahead and no earlier than process start
contract.failure: Independent sources; NaN and success=0 on failure, last successful time retained, no business payload or upstream errors emitted

checks.strict_mypy_scope: Required production sources plus the three read-only telemetry scripts; pre-existing optional capacity/load typing errors are not relabeled as passing

real_integration.targets: Existing local PostgreSQL and Redis; exclusively owned database schema, clients and loopback failure socket
covered: Due pending/retry_wait across ingestion, Agent and Presales; future/running/terminal excluded; empty queue zero
ACCESS EXCLUSIVE table lock causes the bounded queue query to fail while Redis continues; recovery after release
Redis connected-client increase and return after closing the owned client
Real connection failure through an owned non-listening loopback socket and subsequent recovery
Sampler to rendered registry to allowlisted metrics parser
real_integration.cleanup: Fixture drops and verifies absence of its owned schema; owned clients and socket closed; shared services and databases not removed or flushed
real_integration.limitations: Queue transitions are controlled database fixtures, not an end-to-end consumer/load run; concurrent customers and production capacity are not established

failure_evidence: Initial zero-value, missing sampler/query, legacy summary and missing supervisor-argument red tests retained
First real integration fixture omitted Tenant.quota_bytes; original failure retained, corrected fixture passed
First Ruff invocation reported three import-order issues; original failure retained, final Ruff passed; Mypy had already passed
Sandbox read failures for temporary helper scripts preserved in execution history; normal approved escalation used
Earlier frozen live observations and their incomplete/failed findings unchanged
remaining_gaps: Deploy and verify a reviewed candidate on the existing 4C4G host; the previous live observation still lacks producer freshness
Bind business phases to the actual target and candidate identity, prove browser/proxy recovery and run the approved bounded business capacity trials
This sampler does not prove independent domain quality, alert delivery, recurring backups, whole-host RPO/RTO or commercial readiness
private_evidence: Existing centralized task recovery group; resource-producer-artifact-index.json. No credentials, raw observations or private output paths committed.
